title: SparkTPA
description: A Simple, Modern & Customizable /tpa, /tpahere plugin for servers.
body:
# ✨ SparkTPA

A modern, feature-rich teleport request plugin for Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers. SparkTPA replaces outdated TPA systems with beautiful GUIs, clickable chat buttons, BossBar warmups, sounds, titles, particle effects, and a fully customizable experience.

## 🚀 Features

* 📨 Send teleport requests with `/tpa`
* 📍 Request players to teleport to you with `/tpahere`
* 🌐 Request all online players with `/tpahereall`
* 🖱️ Modern GUI Accept/Deny menu
* 💬 Clickable chat buttons
* ⏳ Teleport warmup system
* 📊 BossBar teleport countdown
* 🔊 Custom sounds with SoundManager caching
* ✨ Particle effects for teleport events
* 🎨 MiniMessage support
* 📢 Titles & ActionBars
* 🔇 Ignore specific players
* 🔒 Toggle incoming requests
* 🛡️ Anti-spam protection with CooldownManager
* ⚡ Lightweight & optimized with batch async saving
* 🔧 Fully configurable
* 🚨 Teleport safety checks (lava, magma, campfire, void, solid blocks)
* 🔄 Modrinth update checker (OP-only notifications)
* 📝 Tab completion for all commands

---

![Accept/Deny GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d1a35bb56114af9e8f478d05d4f51f2ea64611.png)

## 📖 Commands

| Command               | Description                     |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `/tpa <player>`       | Send a teleport request         |
| `/tpahere <player>`   | Ask a player to teleport to you |
| `/tpahereall`         | Request all online players      |
| `/tpaccept <player>`  | Accept a request                |
| `/tpadeny <player>`   | Deny a request                  |
| `/tpacancel`          | Cancel an outgoing request      |
| `/tpaignore <player>` | Ignore/unignore a player        |
| `/tpatoggle`          | Toggle all incoming requests    |
| `/sparktpa reload`    | Reload configuration files      |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission                | Use              |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `sparktpa.tpa`            | Use `/tpa`               |
| `sparktpa.tpahere`        | Use `/tpahere`           |
| `sparktpa.tpahereall`     | Use `/tpahereall`        |
| `sparktpa.accept`         | Use `/tpaccept`          |
| `sparktpa.deny`           | Use `/tpadeny`           |
| `sparktpa.cancel`         | Use `/tpacancel`         |
| `sparktpa.ignore`         | Use `/tpaignore`         |
| `sparktpa.toggle`         | Use `/tpatoggle`         |
| `sparktpa.admin`          | Access admin commands    |
| `sparktpa.bypasscooldown` | Bypass request cooldowns |
| `sparktpa.bypassdelay`    | Bypass teleport warmups  |
| `sparktpa.safety.bypass`  | Bypass teleport safety checks |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

SparkTPA is fully configurable:

* 🎨 Messages with MiniMessage formatting
* 🔊 Sounds with SoundManager caching
* ⏳ Cooldowns with centralized CooldownManager
* ⏰ Request expiration
* 📊 BossBar settings (color, style, title, sounds)
* 🖱️ GUI settings (title, accept/deny items)
* 📢 Titles & ActionBars
* 🚀 Teleport warmups
* ✨ Particle effects (request-sent, request-accepted, request-denied, teleport, arrival)
* 🛡️ Safety checks (lava, magma, campfire, void, solid blocks)
* 🔄 Update checker (Modrinth integration)

---

## 📦 Supported Versions

* Paper 1.21+
* Purpur 1.21+
* Spigot 1.21+

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the latest `sparktpa-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin in `plugins/SparkTPA/config.yml` and `plugins/SparkTPA/messages.yml`

---

## ⚡ Performance Optimizations

SparkTPA is optimized for small servers and SMPs:

* 🔄 Single cleanup task for request expiration (instead of per-request tasks)
* 💾 Batch async saving every 5 minutes (reduces disk I/O)
* 🔊 SoundManager caching (avoids repeated enum lookups)
* 🚫 Particle effects disabled by default (can be enabled in config)
* ⚡ Removed unnecessary synchronization (ConcurrentHashMap is thread-safe)
* 📦 Lightweight memory footprint
* 🎯 Minimal CPU overhead
